description: Who runs agents and under which guardrail profile: users by directory and domain, verified vs claimed principals, SSH vs local sessions, agent identities (agt-) and their sessions (ais-), profile selection with match reasons and policy digests, and identity.observed group counts. Identity here is attribution read from the operating system, not authentication.

panels.title: Users observed
panels.description: Distinct users (user.id) with an `identity.observed` record in the range: verified users whose directory facts resolved. The gateway writes one per user every 15 minutes at most. A per-user macOS install resolves none.

targets.expr: count(sum by (user_id) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | event_name="identity.observed" | label_format user_id="{{.body_user_id}}" | user_id!="" [$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Agent identities (agt-)
panels.description: Distinct stable agent identities (`defenseclaw.agent.identity.id`, `agt-` + 16 hex) on hook decisions and tool invocations in the range: one per harness install, user and machine.

targets.expr: count(sum by (agent_identity) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | event_name=~"hook_decision|tool[.]invocation[.].*" | connector=~"$connector" | body_defenseclaw_agent_identity_id=~"agt-.+" | label_format agent_identity="{{.body_defenseclaw_agent_identity_id}}" [$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Agent sessions (ais-)
panels.description: Distinct agent sessions (`defenseclaw.agent.instance_id`) that belong to an agent identity in the range.

targets.expr: count(sum by (agent_session) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | event_name=~"hook_decision|tool[.]invocation[.].*" | connector=~"$connector" | body_defenseclaw_agent_identity_id=~"agt-.+" | label_format agent_session="{{or .body_defenseclaw_agent_instance_id .correlation_agent_instance_id}}" | agent_session!="" [$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Verified principal share
panels.description: Share of hook decisions and tool calls whose identity facts the gateway resolved itself for a kernel- or credential-verified uid or SID (`verified`), against records that carry only what the hook reported (`claimed`). Only verified facts can select a guardrail profile.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | event_name=~"hook_decision|tool[.]invocation[.].*" | connector=~"$connector" | body_defenseclaw_user_principal_assurance="verified" [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | event_name=~"hook_decision|tool[.]invocation[.].*" | connector=~"$connector" | body_defenseclaw_user_principal_assurance=~"verified|claimed" [$__range]))

panels.title: Users by directory and domain
panels.description: Distinct verified users per directory (local, ldap, active_directory, entra_id, okta, other) and domain, from `identity.observed`. `unreported` directory on Linux SSSD means the guardian's realm facts are not available (per-user install).

targets.expr: count by (directory, domain) (sum by (directory, domain, user_id) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | event_name="identity.observed" | body_user_id!="" | label_format directory="{{if .body_defenseclaw_user_directory}}{{.body_defenseclaw_user_directory}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}", domain="{{if .body_defenseclaw_user_domain}}{{.body_defenseclaw_user_domain}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}", user_id="{{.body_user_id}}" [$__range])))

panels.title: Verified vs claimed identity
panels.description: Distinct users by the assurance of the identity facts on their hook decisions and tool calls. `claimed` means the gateway resolved no directory facts and the record carries what the hook reported.

targets.expr: count by (assurance) (sum by (assurance, user_id) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | event_name=~"hook_decision|tool[.]invocation[.].*" | connector=~"$connector" | body_user_id!="" | body_defenseclaw_user_principal_assurance=~"verified|claimed" | label_format assurance="{{.body_defenseclaw_user_principal_assurance}}", user_id="{{.body_user_id}}" [$__range])))

panels.title: SSH vs local sessions
panels.description: Distinct agent sessions by the login session they ran in (`defenseclaw.session.kind`: local, ssh, rdp or console). The kind is reported only at the assurance of the record's directory facts, so Windows and macOS sessions with verified directory facts show as `unreported`; Linux sessions are verified through logind or utmp.

targets.expr: count by (session_kind) (sum by (session_kind, agent_session) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | event_name=~"hook_decision|tool[.]invocation[.].*" | connector=~"$connector" | label_format session_kind="{{if .body_defenseclaw_session_kind}}{{.body_defenseclaw_session_kind}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}", agent_session="{{or .body_defenseclaw_agent_instance_id .correlation_agent_instance_id}}" | agent_session!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Agents per user (agt- ids)
panels.description: Distinct agent identities each user ran in the range. Principal (for example alice@CORP.EXAMPLE.COM) is filled only when `ai_discovery.include_user_principal` is on.

targets.expr: count by (user_id, user_name, principal) (sum by (user_id, user_name, principal, agent_identity) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | event_name=~"hook_decision|tool[.]invocation[.].*" | connector=~"$connector" | body_defenseclaw_agent_identity_id=~"agt-.+" | label_format user_id="{{.body_user_id}}", user_name="{{.body_defenseclaw_user_name}}", principal="{{.body_defenseclaw_user_principal}}", agent_identity="{{.body_defenseclaw_agent_identity_id}}" [$__range])))

panels.title: Sessions per agent
panels.description: Distinct sessions (`ais-`) per agent identity (`agt-`) in the range. The agent ID is stable across gateway restarts; a new session ID marks a new chat.

targets.expr: count by (agent_identity, connector, user_name) (sum by (agent_identity, connector, user_name, agent_session) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | event_name=~"hook_decision|tool[.]invocation[.].*" | connector=~"$connector" | body_defenseclaw_agent_identity_id=~"agt-.+" | label_format agent_identity="{{.body_defenseclaw_agent_identity_id}}", user_name="{{.body_defenseclaw_user_name}}", agent_session="{{or .body_defenseclaw_agent_instance_id .correlation_agent_instance_id}}" | agent_session!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Decisions by guardrail profile and match reason
panels.description: Hook decisions per selected guardrail profile and the reason it was selected (agent, user, group, connector, default, default_unverified, default_lookup_failed). `none` means no profiles are configured.

targets.expr: sum by (profile, profile_match) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | event_name="hook_decision" | connector=~"$connector" | label_format profile="{{if .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_profile_name}}{{.body_defenseclaw_guardrail_profile_name}}{{else}}none{{end}}", profile_match="{{if .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_profile_match}}{{.body_defenseclaw_guardrail_profile_match}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Profile selection audit
panels.description: Hook decisions in the range per profile, match reason, matched group and action. Use it to confirm which group put a user in a profile.

targets.expr: sum by (profile, profile_match, matched_group, action) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | event_name="hook_decision" | connector=~"$connector" | label_format profile="{{if .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_profile_name}}{{.body_defenseclaw_guardrail_profile_name}}{{else}}none{{end}}", profile_match="{{if .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_profile_match}}{{.body_defenseclaw_guardrail_profile_match}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}", matched_group="{{.body_defenseclaw_guardrail_profile_matched_group}}", action="{{.body_defenseclaw_guardrail_effective_action}}" [$__range]))

panels.title: Profile digest timeline
panels.description: Hook decisions per profile and policy digest over time. A new digest series marks the reload where that profile's effective policy changed; `defenseclaw guardrail profile explain` reports the current digest.

targets.expr: sum by (profile, digest) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | event_name="hook_decision" | connector=~"$connector" | body_defenseclaw_guardrail_profile_digest!="" | label_format profile="{{.body_defenseclaw_guardrail_profile_name}}", digest="{{.body_defenseclaw_guardrail_profile_digest}}" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Directory group counts
panels.description: The largest group count per user from `identity.observed` in the range. The record carries counts only, never group names.

targets.expr: max by (user_id, user_name, directory, domain, source, assurance) (max_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | event_name="identity.observed" | label_format user_id="{{.body_user_id}}", user_name="{{.body_defenseclaw_user_name}}", directory="{{if .body_defenseclaw_user_directory}}{{.body_defenseclaw_user_directory}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}", domain="{{if .body_defenseclaw_user_domain}}{{.body_defenseclaw_user_domain}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}", source="{{if .body_defenseclaw_user_identity_source}}{{.body_defenseclaw_user_identity_source}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}", assurance="{{if .body_defenseclaw_user_principal_assurance}}{{.body_defenseclaw_user_principal_assurance}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}" | unwrap body_defenseclaw_user_group_count | __error__="" [$__range]))

list.name: user
list.label: User regex
list.description: Regex over user.id (uid or SID), the account name or the directory principal (case-insensitive). Every panel on this board reads Loki, so every panel is narrowed.

title: DefenseClaw — Identity & Users
